
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiezhr/p/22560344" title="发布于 2026-08-19 08:08">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DeepSeek Harness 值得安装的 15 款插件</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>大家好，我是晓凡。</p>
<p>最近 <strong>DeepSeek Harness</strong>（DSH）火得一塌糊涂，GitHub 仓库 Star 破 15 万，如果还不知道<code>DeepSeek Harness</code>是啥的，可以先看看<a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/wKgp2L2aF0Y_hKnodqsmWw" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">开源三天 12 万 Star！DeepSeek Harness 到底是个啥？小白安装到实战一篇讲透</a> 补补课。</p>
<p>社区插件生态也是爆发式增长——目前也有<strong>1700多个插件</strong>。</p>
<p>但插件太多也是个问题：哪些值得装？哪些是坑？我对照 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录筛出 <strong>15 款真正值得安装的插件</strong>，直接照着装就行。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="一桌面与界面先把体验拉满">一、桌面与界面：先把体验拉满</h2>
<p>默认的 dsh web 就是个纯聊天框，用久了觉得太素。这 5 款插件分别从<strong>桌面端、Web UI、侧边栏、终端、插件市场</strong>五个角度把体验拉满。</p>
<h3 id="1-deepseek-harness-desktop--13211">1. deepseek-harness-desktop ⭐ 13,211</h3>
<p>把 DSH 封装成 <strong>原生桌面应用</strong>，系统托盘常驻、独立窗口，比网页版更顺滑，告别浏览器标签页被误关的痛。整个生态 Star 最高的项目。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642380-520303833.jpg" alt="deepseek-harness-desktop" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642448-138178042.png" alt="desktop-preview.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 官方主界面：桌面双栏工作台</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：13,211</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-dsh-web-ui--4485">2. dsh-web-ui ⭐ 4,485</h3>
<p>一站式 Web UI 全家桶，集成侧边栏、任务看板、统计面板，把默认界面直接升级成<strong>专业工作台</strong>。颜值党首选，如果只装一个界面插件就装它。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642754-726323097.png" alt="dsh-web-ui" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642729-365982265.jpg" alt="dsh-web-ui" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ Web UI 全家桶主界面</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：4,485</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="3-dsh-better-sidebar--2125">3. dsh-better-sidebar ⭐ 2,125</h3>
<p>重做工作台侧边栏，<strong>文件树、内嵌终端、Git 分支状态</strong>一目了然，信息密度拉满，少切窗口多干活。和 dsh-web-ui 互不冲突，可叠加使用。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642590-677103166.jpg" alt="dsh-better-sidebar" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080643571-1700027923.png" alt="工作台侧边栏" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 侧边栏工作台：文件树 + 终端 + Git</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：2,125</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="4-dsh-tui--1941">4. dsh-TUI ⭐ 1,941</h3>
<p>终端界面（TUI）党的福音，<strong>全屏终端里跑 DSH</strong>，纯键盘流操作，远程服务器、无图形界面环境、vim 爱好者的首选方案。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642706-731790720.jpg" alt="dsh-TUI" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 全屏终端 TUI 启动界面</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：1,941</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="5-dsh-market--987">5. dsh-market ⭐ 987</h3>
<p>内置插件市场，<strong>浏览、搜索、一键安装</strong>生态插件，相当于把应用商店搬进了 DSH，发现好插件不用再到处翻 GitHub。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642704-1268880653.jpg" alt="dsh-market" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 插件市场演示界面</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：980</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="二视觉与搜索补齐多模态短板">二、视觉与搜索：补齐多模态短板</h2>
<p>DeepSeek 本身是纯文本模型，最大短板是<strong>看不了图、搜不了网</strong>。这 3 款插件通过视觉桥接和联网搜索补齐短板。</p>
<h3 id="6-modlens--3036">6. modlens ⭐ 3,036</h3>
<p>DSH 首个视觉插件，Star 最高的视觉类插件。把<code>截图粘贴进对话</code>，它就能看图、识图、理解 UI，报错截图直接扔给它分析。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642666-644424945.jpg" alt="modlens" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642391-808751642.jpg" alt="Three images dropped together, read one by one" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 演示：把截图粘贴给 DSH 识别</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/liustack/modlens" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/liustack/modlens</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：3,036</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="7-modsearch--144">7. modsearch ⭐ 144</h3>
<p>联网搜索插件，让 DSH <strong>实时查资料、引用来源</strong>，弥补模型知识截止日期的短板。和 modlens 同作者，配套使用体验更佳。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642449-482279091.jpg" alt="modsearch" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 演示：联网搜索实时查资料</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/liustack/modsearch" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/liustack/modsearch</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：144</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="8-dsh-imagegen--6">8. dsh-imagegen ⭐ 6</h3>
<p>对话里直接生图，输入 prompt 即返回图片，把 DSH 变成<strong>随手出图的工具</strong>，不用再切到专门的生图软件。Star 少但功能直接。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642572-804901654.jpg" alt="dsh-imagegen" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 对话中生图演示</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/dickpy/dsh-imagegen" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dickpy/dsh-imagegen</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：6</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="三智能体与文件让-agent-更会干活">三、智能体与文件：让 Agent 更会干活</h2>
<p>单打独斗不够爽？这 3 款插件让 DSH <strong>组队干活、精准读文件、全局搜代码</strong>。</p>
<h3 id="9-dsh-agent-teams--536">9. dsh-agent-teams ⭐ 536</h3>
<p>多智能体协作框架，把大任务拆给<strong>多个 agent 并行处理</strong>、协同交付，相当于给 DSH 配了一支小团队，适合复杂项目级任务。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642719-650571147.jpg" alt="dsh-agent-teams" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 多智能体协作界面</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：536</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="10-dsh-at-file--366">10. dsh-at-file ⭐ 366</h3>
<p>聊天里用 <code>@</code> 直接引用文件或目录，把精准上下文投喂给模型，<strong>告别复制粘贴大段代码</strong>。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642608-1070795161.jpg" alt="dsh-at-file" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 聊天中 @ 引用文件演示</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-at-file" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-at-file</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：366</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="11-dsh-workspace-search--4">11. dsh-workspace-search ⭐ 4</h3>
<p>工作区全文搜索，在代码和文件里<strong>快速定位关键词、函数、配置</strong>，相当于给工作区装了个全局「grep + 跳转」。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642644-978367536.jpg" alt="dsh-workspace-search" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 工作区全文搜索演示</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/tsonglew/dsh-workspace-search" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/tsonglew/dsh-workspace-search</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：4</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="四效率与安全把账算清把活干稳">四、效率与安全：把账算清、把活干稳</h2>
<p>这 4 款是<strong>进阶能力</strong>——用量计费、上下文体检、电脑控制、安全研究，按需安装。</p>
<h3 id="12-dsh-usage-stats--18">12. dsh-usage-stats ⭐ 18</h3>
<p>Token 用量与计费统计面板，把每一次对话的消耗可视化，<strong>看清「钱花在哪」</strong>，帮助控制 API 成本。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642402-1840119493.jpg" alt="dsh-usage-stats" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ Token 用量统计面板</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/Make0209/dsh-usage-stats" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/Make0209/dsh-usage-stats</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：18</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="13-dsh-context-doctor--14">13. dsh-context-doctor ⭐ 14</h3>
<p>上下文体检工具，检查上下文是否超量、有无冗余内容，帮你<strong>瘦身对话上下文</strong>，避免令牌浪费和模型跑偏。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642390-365020699.jpg" alt="dsh-context-doctor" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 上下文体检结果界面</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：14</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="14-dsh-computer-use--16">14. dsh-computer-use ⭐ 16</h3>
<p>浏览器/电脑控制自动化，让 DSH <strong>自动操作网页、点击按钮、填写表单</strong>，把「帮我上网站点一下」变成自动执行。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642351-1970954113.jpg" alt="dsh-computer-use" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ 浏览器自动化设置中心</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/ZRui-C/dsh-computer-use" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ZRui-C/dsh-computer-use</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：16</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="15-dsh-reverse-skill--32">15. dsh-reverse-skill ⭐ 32</h3>
<p>安全研究技能包，集成逆向、审计相关的工具与流程，方便安全研究人员在 DSH 里<strong>统一调度安全任务</strong>。Star 少但含金量高。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642633-171737062.jpg" alt="dsh-reverse-skill" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>▸ GitHub 仓库封面图</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>GitHub</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/dhicoc/dsh-reverse-skill" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dhicoc/dsh-reverse-skill</a></li>
<li><strong>Star</strong>：32</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="五安装方式与选型建议">五、安装方式与选型建议</h2>
<p>安装一条命令搞定，<strong>极简安装</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dsh plugin --profile web add "github:owner/repo#main"
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>🕳 <strong>踩坑提示</strong>：启动 Web UI 时必须加 <code>--patch</code> 参数，否则技能和部分插件不生效。完整命令：<code>npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web --patch</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p>也可以直接把插件的GitHub地址丢给AI，让AI帮你安装。</p>
<p>例如想要安装deepseek-harness-desktop这个插件，只需要在DeepSeek Harness 网页中，随便选一个工作目录。然后把下面话丢给它，等着安装就行</p>
<blockquote>
<p>帮我安装 <a href="https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop</a> 这个插件</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642401-148823765.png" alt="安装插件中" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2381533/202608/2381533-20260819080642424-292646419.png" alt="桌面端安装成功" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>选型建议：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>▸ 新手优先：desktop → web-ui → market，先把体验拉满</li>
<li>▸ 效率向：better-sidebar + at-file + workspace-search，把读写代码链路做顺</li>
<li>▸ 能力向：modlens + modsearch + imagegen，补齐多模态短板</li>
<li>▸ 成本向：usage-stats + context-doctor，把账算清、把上下文管住</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="写在最后">写在最后</h2>
<p>DeepSeek Harness 的口号是「一切皆插件」。从这 15 款插件来看，界面、视觉、搜索、协作、安全全都可以拆下来换掉。这么多插件，总有一款适合你。</p>
<hr>
<p>我是晓凡，再小的帆也能远航。热衷于分享一些好玩的实用的干货内容。</p>
<p>本期内容到这儿就结束了，希望文章对您有所帮助，我们下期再见 ヾ(•ω•`)o</p>
